title: An unadmitted turn in a clean, unchanged named root is recorded as "source change (assumed_missing_baseline)", which invalidates a valid acceptance evaluation
outcome: When a turn's source baseline is missing but the named root's measured source identity before and after equals the evaluated cut (same commit, tree, zero changes), the host does not report a source change. A completed, still-valid acceptance evaluation is not made stale by a turn that changed nothing.
acceptance: A behavioural test: after an acceptance evaluation of a clean named root at commit C, an unadmitted turn whose baseline is missing, while the root's measured source id stays C with 0 changes, records no source change (source_changed false, or an explicit no-change accounting), and done consumes the evaluation
A behavioural test: a turn with a missing baseline where the root's source id actually differs from the evaluated cut still records a source change, and done still refuses as today
The host never emits two observations for the same turn window that disagree on source_changed for the same root and identical source id
